method: static audit of item anchors against the signed snapshot. No model calls, no substrate needed.
scope: GSPC governance axis, n=24, every item carrying a ground-truth provision anchor

THE_HOLE.what: Annex III is present in the signed pack as ONE point — 4(a), recruitment and selection. The Act defines eight Annex III categories, and the item bank cites six others: points 2, 3(a), 5(a), 5(b), 5(c) and 7. None are in the corpus.
THE_HOLE.consequence: 6 of 8 HIGH_RISK items cannot be grounded at all. Annex III IS the high-risk classification mechanism — Art 6(2) says an AI system is high-risk if it falls under Annex III. A corpus holding Art 6(2) but not the Annex it points to contains the rule and not the list the rule resolves against.
high_risk_items_ungroundable: Annex III 5(a) essential services / emergency triage
Annex III 2 critical infrastructure safety component
Annex III 5(c) life/health insurance risk assessment
also_missing: Article 2(6) — the scientific R&D scope exclusion
Recitals — the snapshot captures no recital text at all

SELECTION_EFFECT_THIS_CREATES.why_it_matters: PROHIBITED is 29% of the axis but 50% of what the corpus can ground. Any grounded-arm score computed on 'the items we could retrieve for' is measured on an easier, differently-shaped subset than the closed-book arm. Reporting the two against each other without pairing on identical items would manufacture a lift out of the coverage hole.

what_this_means_for_the_thesis: 'Out-ground, not out-think' is a claim about a corpus. Before asking whether the corpus helps a model, the corpus has to contain the law the questions turn on. On the axis built to test governance knowledge, it contains it for 14 of 24 items and for only 2 of the 8 highest-stakes ones. This is fixable — the missing text is public, and adding it is retrieval work, not research — but it must be fixed BEFORE any grounding result is quoted, because right now a null result is confounded with a corpus that lacks the answer.
fix: ingest the remaining Annex III points, Article 2, and the cited recitals into the signed snapshot, re-verify hashes, re-run.
